cheap_en: Store-brand (Walmart Equate, Target Up&Up) is identical; ask OB for free samples or a prescription Medicaid covers.
cheap_zh: 超市自有品牌成分相同；可向产科医生要免费样品，或开处方由Medicaid报销。

cheap_en: Medicaid/CHIP pregnancy coverage, community health centers and Planned Parenthood use sliding-scale fees; apply the day you test positive.
cheap_zh: Medicaid/CHIP孕期保险、社区健康中心按收入收费；验孕阳性当天就去申请。

qty_en: 1 daily if your OB finds low iron
qty_zh: 医生确认缺铁后每天1片
cheap_en: Generic ferrous sulfate is a few dollars; take with vitamin C and skip the pricey 'gentle iron' brands.
cheap_zh: 普通硫酸亚铁几美元；配维C服用，不必买昂贵的“温和铁”。

cheap_en: Hospitals, WIC and county health departments run free classes; YouTube and the free Lamaze online series also work.
cheap_zh: 医院、WIC和县卫生局常有免费课；YouTube和Lamaze免费网课也够用。

cheap_en: Thrift stores and Buy Nothing groups are full of barely-worn maternity wear; a $6 belly band also lets you keep your own jeans unbuttoned.
cheap_zh: 二手店和Buy Nothing群里孕妇装几乎全新；6美元托腹带还能让原来的牛仔裤解扣继续穿。

qty_en: 4-5 tops that also work for nursing
cheap_en: Buy men's or oversized regular tees cheaply; choose button-front or wrap styles so they work after birth too.
cheap_zh: 买便宜的大码或男款T恤；选前开扣或交叉款，产后哺乳也能穿。

cheap_en: Walmart/Target 2-packs around $15; buy late in pregnancy so the size still fits when milk comes in.
cheap_zh: 沃尔玛/Target两件装约15美元；孕晚期再买，下奶后仍合身。

cheap_en: Only buy if your back or pelvis hurts; thrifted or borrowed ones wash clean fine.
cheap_zh: 腰骨盆痛再买；二手或借用的洗干净照样用。

cheap_en: Two bed pillows between the knees and under the belly do the same job for free.
cheap_zh: 两个普通枕头夹腿和垫肚子，效果一样还免费。

cheap_en: Generic 15-20 mmHg multipacks; elevating feet and walking help as much.
cheap_zh: 普通15-20mmHg多双装；抬腿和散步同样有效。

cheap_en: Store-brand Tums equivalent; confirm dose with your OB.
cheap_zh: 超市自有品牌等同Tums；用量先问医生。

cheap_en: Generic docusate is $4; prunes, water and walking are cheaper first steps.
cheap_zh: 普通多库酯4美元；先试西梅、多喝水、多走路。

label_en: Unscented body lotion for itchy belly
label_zh: 无香身体乳（缓解肚皮痒）
cheap_en: Plain store-brand cocoa butter or coconut oil; no cream prevents stretch marks, so never pay premium prices.
cheap_zh: 普通可可脂或椰子油即可；没有任何霜能防妊娠纹，别买贵的。

qty_en: Travel toiletries, phone charger (long cord), lip balm, hair ties, flip-flops
qty_zh: 旅行装洗漱品、加长充电线、润唇膏、皮筋、拖鞋
cheap_en: Use dollar-store travel sizes and what's already in your bathroom; the hospital supplies pads, mesh underwear and peri bottle free — ask for extras.
cheap_zh: 用一元店旅行装和家里现成的；医院免费提供产褥垫、网眼内裤和冲洗瓶，记得多要几份。

cheap_en: Hospital gowns and grippy socks are free; bring an old dark robe from home instead of buying.
cheap_zh: 医院的病号服和防滑袜免费；带件家里的深色旧睡袍就行。

qty_en: 1 newborn + 1 size 0-3m outfit with legs (for car seat straps)
qty_zh: 新生儿码和0-3月码各1套，分腿款（方便安全座椅）
cheap_en: A plain onesie and a hat is enough; thrift or hand-me-down.
cheap_zh: 一件连体衣加帽子就够；二手或朋友送的都行。

qty_en: 1, installed before 36 weeks; hospital won't discharge without it
qty_zh: 1个，36周前装好；没有座椅医院不让出院
cheap_en: Many WIC offices, fire departments and Safe Kids programs give free seats and free install checks. Never buy used unless you know its full history and it's under 6 years old and never crashed.
cheap_zh: 很多WIC、消防局和Safe Kids项目免费发座椅并免费检查安装。二手只在确知来历、6年内未出过事故时才可用。

label_en: Bassinet or play yard for room-sharing
label_zh: 摇篮/游戏床（同房不同床）
qty_en: 1 flat, firm sleep surface next to your bed
cheap_en: Many states' health departments give free Pack 'n Plays or baby boxes; Buy Nothing groups have them constantly. Just need a new firm mattress/sheet.
cheap_zh: 不少州卫生局免费发Pack'n Play或婴儿箱；Buy Nothing群经常有。只需配新的硬垫和床单。

qty_en: 2-3 fitted sheets that match the mattress exactly
qty_zh: 2-3条，必须与床垫尺寸完全贴合
cheap_en: Store-brand 2-packs $10; nothing else goes in the bed — no bumpers, pillows or blankets.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌两条装约10美元；床上不放护栏垫、枕头和被子。

qty_en: 1 small pack newborn + 2 packs size 1 (babies outgrow NB fast)
cheap_en: Store brands (Up&Up, Parent's Choice) work the same; don't stockpile newborn size. Diaper banks and churches give free packs.
cheap_zh: 超市自有品牌同样好用；NB码别囤。尿布银行和教会常免费发放。

cheap_en: Store-brand water wipes in bulk; warm water and a washcloth work for the first weeks.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌大包装；头几周用温水和小毛巾也可以。

cheap_en: Generic 40% zinc oxide or plain petroleum jelly.
cheap_zh: 普通40%氧化锌或凡士林。

qty_en: 1 pad + 2 covers, or a towel on the floor
cheap_en: Skip the changing table entirely; a folded towel on a bed or floor is safest and free.
cheap_zh: 完全不用买尿布台；床上或地上铺毛巾最安全还免费。

label_zh: 新生儿连体衣与连脚睡衣
qty_zh: 连体衣6-8件、睡衣6件，NB和0-3月码
cheap_en: Thrift stores sell these at $1 each and Buy Nothing groups give full bundles; buy more 0-3m than newborn.
cheap_zh: 二手店1美元一件，Buy Nothing群常送整包；0-3月码多备，NB码少买。

cheap_en: Hospital receiving blankets are free — take them home; they double as burp cloths and nursing covers.
cheap_zh: 医院的包被免费，带回家；还能当拍嗝巾和哺乳遮挡。

cheap_en: Hospital gives a hat; socks come in cheap multipacks, and sleeve cuffs replace mittens.
cheap_zh: 医院送帽子；袜子买多双装，袖口翻折就当手套。

qty_en: 2, TOG matched to your room temp
cheap_en: Store-brand or second-hand; loose blankets are never safe in the crib, so this is the safe swap.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌或二手；婴儿床里不能放松散被子，睡袋是安全替代。

cheap_en: Insurance and Medicaid must cover one free — order through an online DME supplier around week 30. WIC also loans pumps.
cheap_zh: 保险和Medicaid必须免费提供一台，孕30周左右通过医疗器械供应商下单。WIC也出借吸奶器。

cheap_en: Store brand; clean glass jars or hard plastic bottles in the fridge are free for short-term storage.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌；短期存冰箱用干净玻璃瓶或硬塑料瓶即可，免费。

cheap_en: Plain petroleum jelly or your own expressed milk works; hospitals often hand out free tubes.
cheap_zh: 凡士林或自己的母乳涂抹也有效；医院常免费发。

cheap_en: Washable cotton pairs pay for themselves in two weeks.
cheap_zh: 可洗棉质的两周就回本。

cheap_en: Two folded bed pillows do the same thing; used Boppys are everywhere for $5 (wash the cover).
cheap_zh: 两个普通枕头叠起来效果一样；二手Boppy常见5美元（洗套即可）。

qty_en: 3-4 packs overnight maxi pads for 4-6 weeks of bleeding
qty_zh: 夜用加长3-4包，产后出血4-6周
cheap_en: Take every pad, mesh underwear and ice pack the hospital offers — they're already paid for; then buy store-brand overnight pads.
cheap_zh: 医院的产褥垫、网眼内裤、冰袋都拿回家（已含在费用里）；之后买超市自有品牌夜用。

cheap_en: The hospital gives you one free; a clean squeeze bottle works too.
cheap_zh: 医院免费给；干净的挤压瓶也可以。

cheap_en: Cheap cotton briefs from Walmart; hospital mesh underwear is free and surprisingly good — take a stack.
cheap_zh: 沃尔玛便宜棉内裤；医院的网眼内裤免费又好用，多拿几条。

label_zh: 金缕梅湿巾与会阴喷雾
cheap_en: Generic witch hazel poured on pads you already have; hospital usually sends you home with some.
cheap_zh: 普通金缕梅液倒在卫生巾上即可；医院一般也会给一些。

label_zh: 妈妈用布洛芬与对乙酰氨基酚
cheap_en: Generic bottles under $4 each; both are safe while breastfeeding.
cheap_zh: 普通牌子每瓶不到4美元；哺乳期两种都安全。

qty_en: 1 — any fever ≥100.4°F in a newborn is an ER visit
cheap_en: A $7 basic digital stick is more accurate than a $40 forehead scanner.
cheap_zh: 7美元的普通电子体温计比40美元额温枪更准。

label_zh: 吸鼻器与生理盐水滴鼻液
cheap_en: The hospital bulb syringe is free — ask for it; generic saline is $2.
cheap_zh: 医院的吸鼻球免费，记得要；普通盐水2美元。

qty_en: 1 bottle, 400 IU daily from day 1 if breastfeeding
cheap_en: Store-brand 400 IU drops last months; sometimes free from the pediatrician or WIC.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌400IU能用好几个月；儿科或WIC有时免费给。

label_zh: 婴儿指甲锉/圆头指甲剪
cheap_en: An emery board costs $1 and is safer than clippers on newborns.
cheap_zh: 1美元的指甲锉对新生儿比指甲剪更安全。

cheap_en: A clean kitchen sink lined with a towel works perfectly; second-hand tubs are $3.
cheap_zh: 厨房水槽垫块毛巾就行；二手浴盆3美元。

cheap_en: Store-brand wash; regular bath towels are fine, and newborns only need 2-3 baths a week.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌即可；普通浴巾也行，新生儿每周洗2-3次就够。

qty_en: 2-3 bottles if breastfeeding; 6-8 if formula feeding
cheap_en: Store-brand bottles work; the hospital often sends home free ready-to-feed bottles and nipples.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌奶瓶够用；医院常免费给即食奶瓶和奶嘴。

label_zh: 启蒙配方奶（如用配方奶）
qty_en: 1-2 cans of infant formula with iron
cheap_en: WIC covers formula fully — apply during pregnancy. Store brands (Parent's Choice, Up&Up) meet the same FDA standards as name brands.
cheap_zh: WIC全额覆盖配方奶，孕期就申请。自有品牌与大牌同样符合FDA标准。

cheap_en: Cloth diaper prefolds or old flour-sack towels are cheapest and most absorbent.
cheap_zh: 棉尿布或旧棉布毛巾最便宜最吸水。

cheap_en: A clean dish towel replaces the rack; one $2 brush is enough.
cheap_zh: 干净的擦碗布可代替沥水架；2美元的刷子一把就够。

cheap_en: Hospital Soothies are free; store brands cost $1 each.
cheap_zh: 医院的奶嘴免费；自有品牌1美元一个。

cheap_en: A free phone app or a box fan across the room does the job; keep it under 50 dB and away from the crib.
cheap_zh: 免费手机App或一台风扇即可；音量控制在50分贝以下，远离婴儿床。

qty_zh: 1个可从出生用的人体工学背带
cheap_en: Buy Nothing groups and consignment sales have soft carriers constantly; a long stretchy wrap can be sewn from 5 yards of jersey fabric.
cheap_zh: Buy Nothing群和二手市场常有；长弹力背巾可用5码针织布自制。

label_zh: 婴儿推车（可配安全座椅）
cheap_en: Second-hand strollers are safe (unlike car seats) — check Facebook Marketplace, yard sales and Buy Nothing; a frame-only stroller for your car seat is the cheapest option.
cheap_zh: 推车买二手很安全（安全座椅不行）——看二手市场和Buy Nothing群；只买可架安全座椅的车架最省。

cheap_en: Any backpack you already own works better than a branded diaper bag.
cheap_zh: 家里任何双肩包都比品牌妈咪包好用。

qty_en: 1 bottle; wash all baby clothes before birth
cheap_en: Any free-and-clear store brand; no separate 'baby' detergent needed.
cheap_zh: 任何无香超市自有品牌；不必买专门的婴儿洗衣液。

label_zh: 选定儿科医生并办好保险
qty_en: Pick a provider by week 32; baby needs a visit within 3-5 days of birth
qty_zh: 孕32周前选好；宝宝出生后3-5天内要就诊
cheap_en: Free: call your Medicaid/insurance list or a community health center and ask for a prenatal meet-and-greet.
cheap_zh: 免费：按Medicaid/保险名单或社区健康中心打电话，预约产前见面。

label_zh: 插座保护盖与家具固定带
cheap_en: Cheap multipacks; do the anchors before birth while you still have energy — tip-overs are a leading home danger.
cheap_zh: 便宜多件装；趁产前有精力先把家具固定好，倾倒是家中主要危险。

label_zh: 烟雾与一氧化碳报警器
qty_en: 1 per floor, test batteries before birth
cheap_en: Most US fire departments install them free — just call the non-emergency line.
cheap_zh: 美国多数消防局免费上门安装，打非紧急电话即可。

label_en: A few board books for newborn
cheap_en: Library story-time and Dolly Parton's Imagination Library mail free books monthly — sign up as soon as baby is born.
cheap_zh: 图书馆和Imagination Library每月免费寄书，宝宝出生就注册。

label_en: Freezer meals for the first weeks
cheap_en: Double every dinner you cook in month 8 and freeze half; cheaper and better than takeout at 2 a.m.
cheap_zh: 孕8个月起每顿多做一倍冷冻起来；比半夜叫外卖便宜得多。

cheap_en: Store brand (Target Up&Up, Costco Kirkland); buy only 1 pack of Newborn size—babies outgrow it fast; diaper banks and Buy Nothing groups give free packs
cheap_zh: 买超市自有品牌（Target、Costco）；新生儿尺码只买一包，宝宝长得快；尿布银行和邻里互赠群常有免费尿裤

cheap_en: Store-brand bulk boxes; at home a warm wet washcloth works just as well and is free
cheap_zh: 买超市自有品牌大盒装；在家用温水小毛巾一样干净，还免费

cheap_en: Generic 40% zinc oxide or plain petroleum jelly; a thick layer of store-brand works like premium brands
cheap_zh: 买普通40%氧化锌药膏或凡士林，厚涂效果与大牌相同

cheap_en: Skip the changing table—a folded towel on a waterproof pad on the bed or floor is safer and free
cheap_zh: 不用买尿布台，床上或地板铺防水垫加毛巾更安全也省钱

cheap_en: Any step-can with a lid plus grocery bags; special diaper pails need pricey refill cartridges
cheap_zh: 普通带盖垃圾桶配超市塑料袋即可，专用尿布桶的替换芯很贵

cheap_en: Thrift stores, consignment sales, hand-me-downs; babies stain everything so used is ideal
cheap_zh: 二手店、旧衣转卖会或亲友转送；宝宝很容易弄脏，二手最划算

cheap_en: Choose zippers over snaps for night changes; buy used—they're worn only a few weeks
cheap_zh: 选拉链款夜里换方便；买二手，这个尺码只穿几周

cheap_en: Hospital usually sends you home with a hat; socks in multipacks, or fold sleeper cuffs over hands
cheap_zh: 医院通常会送一顶帽子；袜子买多双装，睡衣袖口翻下来就能护手

cheap_en: Hospital receiving blankets are free; velcro swaddles are common in Buy Nothing groups
cheap_zh: 医院发的包被免费；魔术贴襁褓在邻里互赠群很常见

label_en: Bassinet or play yard with newborn level
label_zh: 摇篮床或带新生儿层的游戏床
cheap_en: Many states and WIC offices give free Pack 'n Plays or Cribs for Kids boxes; ask your hospital or health department
cheap_zh: 很多州和WIC办公室免费发放游戏床或婴儿睡箱，可问医院或卫生局

cheap_en: Store brand 2-packs; no bumpers, pillows or loose blankets—those are unsafe and cost money
cheap_zh: 买超市自有品牌两条装；床围、枕头、松散被子都不安全，不要买

cheap_en: Layer sheet-protector-sheet so you can strip one layer at 3am; generic brands fine
cheap_zh: 床单—防水垫—床单交替铺两层，夜里只需撤掉一层；普通品牌即可

cheap_en: A free phone app or a box fan across the room works the same
cheap_zh: 手机免费App或房间里的小风扇效果一样

label_zh: 婴儿提篮式安全座椅（反向安装）
cheap_en: Buy new or from someone you trust—never a seat with unknown crash history or past its expiration date; many hospitals, WIC, and fire departments give free seats and free installation checks
cheap_zh: 买全新或可信亲友的；绝不要来历不明或已过期的座椅；医院、WIC和消防局常提供免费座椅和安装检查

cheap_en: A long stretchy wrap is cheap and newborn-friendly; check Buy Nothing and consignment sales
cheap_zh: 长款弹力背巾便宜又适合新生儿；互赠群和二手转卖会常见

label_en: Stroller (car seat compatible or travel system)
cheap_en: A used frame stroller that clicks your car seat in costs far less than a travel system; check strollers secondhand for working brakes
cheap_zh: 二手车架推车可直接卡提篮，比整套便宜很多；买二手要检查刹车

cheap_en: Any backpack you already own works; add a zip pouch for diapers and wipes
cheap_zh: 家里现成的双肩包就行，里面放个拉链袋装尿裤湿巾

cheap_en: Stacked bed pillows under your arm do the job; used nursing pillows with a washable cover are common and cheap
cheap_zh: 用家里枕头垫在手臂下也一样；二手哺乳枕换个可洗枕套即可

cheap_en: Plain petroleum jelly or your own expressed breast milk rubbed in works; hospitals often hand out free samples
cheap_zh: 凡士林或自己的母乳涂抹也有效；医院常发免费小样

qty_en: 3 soft wire-free bras, size up 1-2 cups
qty_zh: 3件无钢圈软文胸，比孕前大1-2个罩杯
cheap_en: Wire-free sleep bras from Walmart/Target 2-packs; avoid underwire early—it can cause clogged ducts
cheap_zh: 沃尔玛、Target的无钢圈睡眠文胸两件装；早期别穿钢圈，容易堵奶

qty_zh: 每月约60片一次性，或8片可洗
cheap_en: Washable cotton pads pay for themselves in a month; store-brand disposables are half the price of name brands
cheap_zh: 可洗棉垫一个月就回本；超市自有品牌一次性乳垫只要大牌一半价钱

cheap_en: Free through insurance under the ACA—call the number on your card before birth; WIC also loans pumps
cheap_zh: 按美国法律保险可免费提供，产前就打卡上电话申请；WIC也可借用吸奶器

label_zh: 吸奶器配件（喇叭罩、鸭嘴阀、膜片）
qty_en: 1 spare set; replace valves every 1-2 months
qty_zh: 1套备用；鸭嘴阀每1-2个月换一次
cheap_en: Insurance often covers replacement parts too; correct flange size matters more than price—measure your nipple
cheap_zh: 保险通常也报销替换配件；喇叭罩尺寸合适比价格更重要，量一下乳头直径

label_en: Breast milk storage bags or bottles
cheap_en: Store-brand bags; or reuse clean bottles for fridge milk and save bags for freezing only
cheap_zh: 买超市自有品牌；冷藏奶用奶瓶装，储奶袋只用于冷冻

cheap_en: WIC covers formula entirely—apply the week baby is born; store brands (Up&Up, Parent's Choice) meet identical FDA standards as name brands
cheap_zh: WIC可全额提供奶粉，宝宝出生当周就申请；超市自有品牌与大牌同样符合FDA标准

qty_zh: 4-6个4盎司奶瓶+新生儿慢流奶嘴
cheap_en: Start with one brand's 3-pack before buying more—babies have preferences; hospital bottles are yours to take home
cheap_zh: 先买一个牌子的三件装试试，宝宝有偏好；医院用过的奶瓶可以带回家

cheap_en: A clean dish towel on the counter replaces a drying rack; dollar-store bottle brush works fine
cheap_zh: 台面铺干净毛巾代替沥水架；一元店的奶瓶刷就够用

cheap_en: A pack of plain cotton flat cloth diapers or thin dish towels is cheaper and more absorbent than cute ones
cheap_zh: 普通纯棉尿布布或薄毛巾比花哨款更便宜更吸水

cheap_en: The free green hospital pacifiers are the same ones sold in stores; replace every few months
cheap_zh: 医院发的绿色奶嘴和店里卖的是同款；每隔几个月更换

cheap_en: A clean kitchen sink lined with a folded towel works perfectly for the first months
cheap_zh: 厨房水槽垫上折叠毛巾，前几个月完全够用

cheap_en: Store-brand fragrance-free 2-in-1; newborns only need 2-3 baths a week, so one bottle goes far
cheap_zh: 买超市无香二合一；新生儿每周只需洗2-3次，一瓶能用很久

cheap_en: Regular bath towels are fine; buy a cheap multipack of washcloths and use them for baths and burps
cheap_zh: 普通浴巾就行；方巾买多条装，洗澡和拍嗝都能用

label_en: Baby nail file or blunt scissors
cheap_en: An emery board is safest and cheapest—newborn nails tear easily; trim while baby sleeps
cheap_zh: 普通指甲锉最安全也最便宜；趁宝宝睡着时修

cheap_en: A basic $8 digital thermometer is the accurate kind doctors want for under-3-month fevers—skip forehead scanners
cheap_zh: 普通8美元电子温度计最准确，3个月内发烧医生要的就是肛温；不必买额温枪

label_zh: 吸鼻器和生理盐水滴鼻液
cheap_en: The hospital blue bulb syringe is free—ask for it; saline drops are cheap generic
cheap_zh: 医院的蓝色吸鼻球免费，记得要；盐水滴鼻液买普通款很便宜

cheap_en: Required for all breastfed babies and any baby drinking under 32oz formula; store brand is identical and a bottle lasts months
cheap_zh: 母乳宝宝及配方奶不足32盎司者都需补；超市自有品牌成分相同，一瓶可用数月

label_zh: 婴儿对乙酰氨基酚（退烧药）
qty_en: 1 bottle (dose only as your doctor says)
cheap_en: Store brand is the same medicine; do NOT give to a baby under 3 months without calling the doctor first
cheap_zh: 超市自有品牌成分相同；3个月以下必须先咨询医生才可用

cheap_en: Bicycle legs, tummy time and good burping work as well and cost nothing—try those first
cheap_zh: 蹬自行车腿、趴卧和好好拍嗝同样有效且免费，先试这些

cheap_en: Take home every pad, mesh underwear and ice pack from the hospital—it's already paid for; then overnight store-brand maxi pads
cheap_zh: 把医院的卫生巾、网眼内裤和冰袋全部带回家（已含在费用里）；之后买超市夜用加长款

cheap_en: The hospital gives you one—ask for a second; an upside-down sport bottle works too
cheap_zh: 医院会给，可多要一个；倒置的运动水瓶也能用

cheap_en: Hospital usually sends you home with these; otherwise generic witch hazel on a pad in the freezer = free padsicles
cheap_zh: 医院通常会给；或自己把金缕梅水倒在卫生巾上冷冻，自制冰敷垫

cheap_en: Generic docusate is pennies a dose; the first postpartum bowel movement is much easier with it plus water and fiber
cheap_zh: 普通仿制药很便宜；配合多喝水和纤维，产后第一次排便会轻松很多

cheap_en: Keep taking your prenatal—store brand is fine; WIC and some clinics provide them free
cheap_zh: 继续吃孕期维生素即可，超市自有品牌就行；WIC和部分诊所免费提供

cheap_en: Cheap cotton granny briefs in a multipack; essential after a C-section so the waistband sits above the incision
cheap_zh: 买便宜的纯棉高腰内裤多条装；剖腹产尤其需要，腰线要高过伤口

cheap_en: Any loose button-down shirt or a stretchy tank you pull down works—no need for 'nursing' labels
cheap_zh: 宽松开襟衬衫或弹性背心往下拉就行，不必买标着“哺乳”的

qty_en: 1-2 visits in the first 2 weeks if painful feeding or slow weight gain
qty_zh: 头2周若喂奶疼或体重增长慢，咨询1-2次
cheap_en: Covered free by insurance under the ACA; WIC peer counselors and hospital breastfeeding groups are also free
cheap_zh: 按法律保险免费覆盖；WIC同伴辅导员和医院哺乳小组也免费

cheap_en: Hospital perineal ice packs are free—take a stack; a few inches of warm water in a clean bathtub replaces a sitz basin
cheap_zh: 医院的会阴冰袋免费，多拿几个；干净浴缸放浅水就可代替坐浴盆

cheap_en: Needed once baby shows signs of rolling and swaddling must stop; buy used, TOG 1.0 for most rooms
cheap_zh: 宝宝有翻身迹象必须停止包裹时用；可买二手，常温房间选1.0 TOG

cheap_en: A folded quilt or blanket on the floor is all a newborn needs; tummy time starts day one, a few minutes at a time
cheap_zh: 地上铺一条折叠被子就够；从出生第一天起每次几分钟趴卧

cheap_en: Print free patterns at the library or draw thick black shapes on white paper—newborns only see high contrast at 8-12 inches
cheap_zh: 图书馆免费打印或自己用黑笔在白纸上画粗图形；新生儿只能看清20-30厘米内的高对比图案

cheap_en: Library card is free and many libraries give a free book at newborn story time; Reach Out and Read gives books at well visits
cheap_zh: 图书馆借阅免费，很多图书馆的婴儿故事会还送书；儿保门诊的Reach Out and Read项目也赠书

qty_zh: 1个（仅限清醒有人看护时使用）
cheap_en: Buy used—they're outgrown by 5 months; never let baby sleep in it, move them to a flat firm surface
cheap_zh: 买二手，5个月就用不上了；绝不能让宝宝在里面睡觉，要移到平坦硬床面

cheap_en: Store-brand free & clear for the whole family's wash—no need for separate 'baby' detergent
cheap_zh: 全家一起用超市无香型即可，不必单买“婴儿”洗衣液

label_zh: 插座保护盖和家具固定带
cheap_en: Install anchors now while you have time, not when baby crawls; dollar-store outlet plugs work the same
cheap_zh: 趁现在有空就装好固定带，别等会爬了；一元店的插座塞一样管用

label_zh: 烟雾和一氧化碳报警器
cheap_en: Your local fire department installs them free—just call and ask
cheap_zh: 当地消防局免费上门安装，打电话问即可

label_en: Basic first aid: gauze, alcohol swabs for cord care
label_zh: 基础护理用品：纱布、酒精棉片（脐带护理）
cheap_en: Umbilical cord care is now just keep it dry and open to air—no alcohol needed; fold the diaper down below the stump
cheap_zh: 现在脐带护理只需保持干燥通风，不必用酒精；把尿裤前沿折到脐带残端下方

label_en: Car seat cover / stroller blanket for weather
label_zh: 安全座椅挡风罩／推车毯
cheap_en: A regular blanket draped over the car seat (never between baby and the straps) is free and safer than puffy coats
cheap_zh: 普通毯子盖在座椅外面即可（不可垫在宝宝和安全带之间），比厚外套更安全也免费

cheap_en: Store brands (Target Up&Up, Costco Kirkland, Walmart Parent's Choice) run about half the price of name brands; buy the next size up on sale; diaper banks and local Buy Nothing groups give away open packs.
cheap_zh: 商超自有品牌（Target、Costco、沃尔玛）价格约为大牌一半；打折时买大一码囤；尿布银行和Buy Nothing群常送拆封整包。

cheap_en: Buy store-brand fragrance-free in bulk refill boxes; plain warm water on a cheap washcloth works just as well at home.
cheap_zh: 买自有品牌无香大包补充装；在家用温水加便宜小毛巾同样好用。

cheap_en: Generic 40% zinc oxide paste is identical to brand name; plain petroleum jelly prevents mild rash for about $2.
cheap_zh: 通用40%氧化锌药膏成分与大牌相同；普通凡士林约2美元即可预防轻微红臀。

cheap_en: A folded towel on any dresser works; thrift stores and Buy Nothing always have contoured pads for free or a few dollars.
cheap_zh: 在任何柜子上铺折叠毛巾即可；二手店或Buy Nothing常免费或几美元就有。

qty_en: About 7–9 large cans/month (24–32 oz per day)
cheap_en: WIC covers formula free for eligible families; store-brand powder (Parent's Choice, Up&Up) meets the same FDA rules as Similac/Enfamil at half the cost.
cheap_zh: 符合条件可通过WIC免费领取；超市自有品牌奶粉符合同样FDA标准，价格约一半。

cheap_en: Baby now drinks 5–7 oz per feed, so move up to 8 oz bottles; store-brand bottles fit most brand nipples. Hospitals and WIC offices often hand out free bottles.
cheap_zh: 此阶段单次吃150–200毫升，需换大奶瓶；自有品牌奶瓶多数可配大牌奶嘴。医院和WIC处常免费发放。

cheap_en: Dollar-store bottle brush plus a clean dish towel on the counter does the same job as a $20 grass rack.
cheap_zh: 一元店奶瓶刷加台面上一块干净布，和20美元的沥水架效果一样。

cheap_en: Insurance (and Medicaid) must cover a double electric pump free — call the number on your card. Replacement valves/duckbills are $5–8 generic; many plans cover those too.
cheap_zh: 保险（含Medicaid）须免费提供双边电动吸奶器，打卡背面电话申请。通用阀门5–8美元，很多保险也报销。

qty_en: About 60–100 bags/month if pumping for work
cheap_en: Store-brand bags cost about half; clean glass jars or hard plastic bottles with lids store milk in the fridge for free.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌价格约一半；干净玻璃罐或带盖硬塑料瓶冷藏存奶完全免费。

cheap_en: Leaking usually slows by month 4; switch to washable cotton pads (6 pairs, ~$8 once) and skip disposables entirely.
cheap_zh: 4个月后溢奶多会减少；改用可洗棉质乳垫（6对约8美元一次性支出）即可。

cheap_en: Walmart/Target 2-packs are about $15; buy now rather than at 1 month since your size has stopped changing. Avoid underwire to prevent clogged ducts.
cheap_zh: 沃尔玛/Target两件装约15美元；此时尺码已定再买更划算。避免钢圈以防堵奶。

cheap_en: Most soreness is gone by 3 months; plain lanolin generic or a drop of your own expressed milk rubbed in costs nothing.
cheap_zh: 3个月后多已不痛；通用羊脂膏或挤几滴母乳涂抹即可，基本零成本。

cheap_en: Second-hand Boppy for $5–10 at thrift stores (wash the cover); two bed pillows work for feeding and propped tummy-time play.
cheap_zh: 二手Boppy在二手店5–10美元（洗净外套）；两个普通枕头同样可用于喂奶和趴卧支撑。

cheap_en: Keep taking your prenatal while nursing; store-brand prenatal is about $8 for 90 days and WIC/Medicaid may cover it.
cheap_zh: 哺乳期继续吃孕期维生素；自有品牌90天约8美元，WIC/Medicaid可能报销。

qty_zh: 8条口水巾，4–6个围嘴（开始流口水）
cheap_en: A pack of plain cotton flat diapers or cheap washcloths works better and costs less than fancy burp cloths.
cheap_zh: 一包纯棉尿布或便宜小毛巾比花哨口水巾更好用且更便宜。

qty_zh: 7–8件连体衣、5件睡衣、4条长裤、6双袜子
cheap_en: Babies blow through sizes — buy bundles at thrift stores, garage sales, or Buy Nothing for $1–2 per piece instead of $8 new.
cheap_zh: 尺码换得快——二手店、旧货市场、Buy Nothing一件1–2美元，远低于新品8美元。

label_en: Seasonal jacket, sun hat or warm hat
qty_en: 1 jacket/fleece, 1 hat, 1 pair mittens if cold
qty_zh: 1件外套/抓绒、1顶帽子、冷天加1副手套
cheap_en: Never use a puffy coat in the car seat — use thin fleece and lay a blanket over the buckled harness. Thrift jackets are $3.
cheap_zh: 安全座椅内禁穿厚棉服——穿薄抓绒，扣好后盖毯子。二手外套约3美元。

cheap_en: Stop swaddling the moment baby shows any rolling — arms-out sleep sacks replace it. Second-hand sacks are $4–6; a warm footed sleeper also works with no blanket.
cheap_zh: 一旦有翻身迹象立即停用襁褓，改用露臂睡袋。二手4–6美元；穿厚连脚睡衣不盖被也可。

label_en: Crib or play yard with firm mattress
label_zh: 婴儿床或游戏床（硬床垫）
qty_en: 1 — most babies outgrow the bassinet now
qty_zh: 1张——此时多数宝宝已不适合摇篮
cheap_en: A Pack 'n Play with its own firm mat is a legal, safe crib and costs $50–70 new or free locally. Never buy a used mattress with tears, or a crib made before 2011.
cheap_zh: 带自带硬垫的Pack 'n Play即是安全合规婴儿床，新品50–70美元，本地常可免费获得。勿买破损床垫或2011年前的婴儿床。

cheap_en: Store-brand 2-packs are about $12. Crib must stay empty otherwise: no pillows, bumpers, or loose blankets.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌两件装约12美元。床内其余必须清空：无枕头、床围、松散毯子。

cheap_en: Free white-noise apps or a box fan across the room do the same thing; keep it under 50 dB and at least 7 feet from the crib.
cheap_zh: 免费白噪音App或房间另一侧的风扇效果相同；音量低于50分贝，距床2米以上。

qty_en: 1; raise harness to shoulder level as baby grows
qty_zh: 1个；随生长把肩带调到肩部高度
cheap_en: Many hospitals, fire departments, WIC and Safe Kids programs give free seats and free installation checks. Never buy used unless you know the full history and expiry date.
cheap_zh: 医院、消防局、WIC和Safe Kids常免费发放并免费安装检查。来源不明或过期的二手座椅绝对不要用。

qty_en: 1 with recline suitable for this age
cheap_en: Thrift and marketplace strollers are $20–40; check brakes and wheels and scrub the fabric. A simple frame that holds your car seat also works.
cheap_zh: 二手店或闲置平台20–40美元；检查刹车和轮子并清洗布面。能放安全座椅的车架也够用。

qty_en: 1, now that baby has head control
cheap_en: Second-hand soft structured carriers are $15–25. Many libraries and hospitals run free babywearing lending groups. Keep baby's chin off chest, face visible.
cheap_zh: 二手软结构背带15–25美元。不少图书馆和医院有免费背巾借用小组。保持下巴离胸、面部可见。

qty_en: 1, for daily tummy time and reaching
qty_zh: 1个，用于每日趴卧和抓握练习
cheap_en: A clean blanket on the floor with 2–3 dangling toys from a chair does the same. Used gyms go for $10 locally.
cheap_zh: 地上铺干净毯子，从椅子上挂2–3个玩具即可。二手健身架本地约10美元。

cheap_en: This is the grabbing stage: a crinkly clean plastic bottle with dry beans sealed shut, or wooden spoons, are free and fascinating. Toy libraries lend sets for free.
cheap_zh: 此阶段爱抓握：装豆子封好的塑料瓶、木勺同样有趣且免费。玩具图书馆可免费借。

cheap_en: Drooling and chewing start now; a clean wet washcloth chilled in the fridge works as well as any teether and is free. Skip amber necklaces — they are a strangling risk.
cheap_zh: 开始流口水爱啃咬；冰箱里冷藏的湿毛巾效果一样且免费。不要用琥珀项链，有窒息风险。

cheap_en: Public libraries lend board books free and run baby story times; Imagination Library and Reach Out and Read mail free books. Thrift books are 50 cents.
cheap_zh: 公共图书馆免费借纸板书并有婴儿故事会；Imagination Library等项目免费寄书。二手书0.5美元。

cheap_en: A clean plastic laundry basin or the kitchen sink with a folded towel works; used tubs are $3–5. Never leave baby alone in water for a second.
cheap_zh: 干净塑料盆或水槽垫毛巾即可；二手浴盆3–5美元。绝不可让宝宝独自留在水中。

qty_zh: 1瓶二合一沐浴露，1瓶无香润肤乳
cheap_en: Store-brand tear-free wash is $2–3 and 2–3 baths a week is plenty. Plain petroleum jelly or generic Aquaphor treats dry patches cheaply.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌无泪沐浴露2–3美元，每周洗2–3次足够。干燥处用凡士林或通用Aquaphor即可。

cheap_en: Regular bath towels are fine; a cheap pack of adult washcloths doubles for baths and burp cloths.
cheap_zh: 普通浴巾完全够用；便宜成人方巾既可洗澡也可当口水巾。

cheap_en: A $3 generic clipper or emery board stops scratching — nails grow fast now and baby's hands reach the face constantly.
cheap_zh: 3美元通用指甲剪或砂纸锉即可防抓伤——此时指甲长得快且手常摸脸。

cheap_en: A $8 drugstore digital thermometer is accurate. Under 6 months, any rectal temp of 100.4°F (38°C) means call the doctor right away.
cheap_zh: 药店8美元数字体温计即准确。6个月内肛温达38℃须立即联系医生。

cheap_en: Hospitals give out blue bulb syringes free; generic saline is $2. No cold medicine is safe at this age — suction and saline are the treatment.
cheap_zh: 医院常免费发蓝色吸鼻球；通用盐水2美元。此月龄禁用感冒药，只能靠吸鼻和盐水。

qty_en: 400 IU daily if breastfed or taking under 32 oz formula
qty_zh: 母乳或奶量不足950毫升者每日400 IU
cheap_en: Store-brand 400 IU drops are $8 for a 2-month supply; WIC and some clinics give them free.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌400 IU滴剂约8美元可用两个月；WIC和部分诊所免费提供。

qty_en: 1 bottle with syringe, for after 4-month shots
qty_zh: 1瓶带注射器，4月龄疫苗后备用
cheap_en: Store brand is $4 and identical. Dose strictly by weight from your doctor — never by age on the box. Ibuprofen is not allowed under 6 months.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌4美元，成分相同。严格按医生给的体重剂量，勿照盒上年龄。6个月内禁用布洛芬。

cheap_en: Medicaid/CHIP and ACA plans cover well visits and shots at no cost; the federal Vaccines for Children program makes vaccines free for uninsured kids.
cheap_zh: Medicaid/CHIP和ACA计划全额覆盖体检和疫苗；联邦VFC项目为无保险儿童免费接种。

qty_en: 1 for the bedroom in dry/winter months
cheap_en: Only needed in dry climates; a pan of water near the heater helps. Clean it every day or it grows mold.
cheap_zh: 仅干燥地区需要；暖气旁放一盆水也有效。必须每天清洗，否则长霉。

label_zh: 插座保护盖和家具固定带
qty_zh: 12–20个盖子，所有柜子和电视都要固定
cheap_en: Do this now while baby is still immobile — rolling and scooting start this stage. Anchor straps are $2 each; some fire departments give them free.
cheap_zh: 趁还不会移动时提前做——此阶段开始翻身挪动。固定带每条约2美元，部分消防局免费提供。

qty_en: 1 bag stocked with diapers, wipes, change of clothes
cheap_en: Any backpack works and is easier on your back; hospitals and WIC often hand out free diaper bags.
cheap_zh: 任何双肩包都可且更护腰；医院和WIC常免费发放妈咪包。

label_en: Stroller sunshade / muslin cover & sun hat
label_zh: 推车遮阳罩／纱布巾和遮阳帽
cheap_en: Under 6 months, shade and clothing come before sunscreen. A clipped muslin cloth is free; never fully enclose the stroller — it traps heat.
cheap_zh: 6个月内优先用遮阴和衣物而非防晒霜。夹一块纱布即可；切勿完全封闭推车，会积热。

cheap_en: Used for $10–20 locally. Never let baby sleep in it — move to a flat crib. Limit to 20–30 minutes at a time so baby gets floor time.
cheap_zh: 本地二手10–20美元。绝不可在其中睡觉，须移至平坦婴儿床。每次限20–30分钟，多留地板活动时间。

cheap_en: You don't need special baby detergent — any free-and-clear store brand washes the whole family's clothes together.
cheap_zh: 不必买婴儿专用洗衣液——任何自有品牌无香型即可全家同洗。

label_en: Mom's postpartum mental health check & support
qty_zh: 持续关注，4–6个月再次筛查
cheap_en: Postpartum depression often shows up at 3–6 months, not just right after birth. Postpartum Support International (1-800-944-4773) and the 988 line are free; ask at the baby's visit — many pediatricians screen moms too.
cheap_zh: 产后抑郁常在3–6个月出现，而非仅产后初期。PSI热线(1-800-944-4773)和988均免费；可在宝宝体检时提出，很多儿科医生也筛查妈妈。

qty_zh: 哺乳每天需额外约400–500千卡
cheap_en: Peanut butter, eggs, oats, bananas and tortillas are the cheapest calories; WIC gives moms free food packages while breastfeeding.
cheap_zh: 花生酱、鸡蛋、燕麦、香蕉、玉米饼最划算；哺乳期妈妈可从WIC领免费食品包。

cheap_en: Store brand (Target Up&Up, Costco Kirkland); buy the biggest box; sign up for brand rewards; ask local diaper bank
cheap_zh: 买超市自有品牌（Target、Costco），买最大包装；申请尿布银行

cheap_en: Store-brand bulk refill packs; plain water + washcloths at home
cheap_zh: 买自有品牌大包装补充装；在家用温水加小毛巾

cheap_en: Store-brand 40% zinc oxide paste works the same as name brands
cheap_zh: 选自有品牌40%氧化锌软膏，和大牌一样

cheap_en: A folded towel on a waterproof mat on the bed works; skip the changing table

cheap_en: Any low wall mirror taped at crawling height; peekaboo with a towel is free
cheap_zh: 低处贴面镜子即可；用毛巾玩躲猫猫免费

cheap_en: Any fragrance-free store-brand detergent — no need for a special baby formula
cheap_zh: 任何无香超市自有品牌即可，不必买婴儿专用

label_zh: 妈妈产后护理（盆底肌、复查）

qty_zh: 每天做盆底肌练习；定期复查
cheap_en: Free YouTube pelvic floor routines; Medicaid covers postpartum visits for 12 months in most states
cheap_zh: YouTube免费教程；多数州Medicaid覆盖产后12个月就诊

label_zh: 妈妈补铁和补水（哺乳期）

qty_zh: 每天多约450大卡，每次喂奶都喝水
cheap_en: Beans, eggs, peanut butter, oats — WIC gives these free to breastfeeding moms
cheap_zh: 豆类、鸡蛋、花生酱、燕麦——WIC为哺乳妈妈免费提供

qty_zh: 持续使用诊所提供的方式

cheap_zh: Title X诊所、Planned Parenthood免费，Medicaid也覆盖

cheap_zh: VFC项目疫苗免费；Medicaid/CHIP覆盖就诊

cheap_en: Store brand (Target Up&Up, Costco Kirkland) in boxes; diaper banks and local Buy Nothing groups give away open packs
cheap_zh: 买超市自有品牌整箱（Target、Costco）；尿布银行和Buy Nothing群常送拆开的包

cheap_zh: 买自有品牌大箱补充装；一般换尿布用温水+小毛巾即可

cheap_zh: 买自有品牌40%氧化锌；日常预防用凡士林

cheap_en: Dollar-store straw cups or a small open cup; drop bottles by 12–15 months for teeth
cheap_zh: 一元店吸管杯或小敞口杯；12–15个月戒奶瓶保护牙齿

qty_en: 3 meals + 2 snacks daily, same food as family
qty_zh: 每天3餐2点心，与家人同食
cheap_en: Feed what the family eats, chopped and unsalted; WIC/SNAP fruit, veg, eggs, beans, oats cost far less than toddler pouches
cheap_zh: 吃家里的饭切小、少盐；WIC/SNAP的水果蔬菜鸡蛋豆类燕麦比幼儿果泥袋便宜得多

cheap_en: Reuse clean yogurt or deli containers
cheap_zh: 洗净的酸奶盒、熟食盒即可

cheap_en: Dollar store or IKEA toddler sets; adult teaspoons work fine too
cheap_zh: 一元店或宜家幼儿餐具；家里的小茶匙也行

cheap_en: Thrift or cut an old adult T-shirt into a smock
cheap_zh: 二手店买，或用旧T恤改成罩衣

qty_zh: 1个；继续后向直到达到身高体重上限

cheap_zh: 二手店或Marketplace $10–25；洗布套、检查刹车

qty_en: 7 tops, 6 bottoms, 4 one-piece outfits, 2 sweaters, 10 pairs socks
qty_zh: 上衣7件、裤子6条、连体衣4套、外套2件、袜子10双

cheap_zh: 换季时二手店买；坐安全座椅前必须脱掉厚外套

cheap_en: Second-hand; or use footed pajamas instead — no loose blankets in the crib yet
cheap_zh: 买二手；也可穿连脚睡衣代替——婴儿床里仍不放松软被子

label_en: Crib with firm mattress + fitted sheets

qty_zh: 婴儿床1张、床垫1个、床笠3条；床板降到最低
cheap_en: Free cribs from Cribs for Kids and Buy Nothing (made after 2011, no drop side); buy only the mattress new
cheap_zh: Cribs for Kids和Buy Nothing可免费拿（2011年后生产、非可下拉护栏）；只买新床垫

cheap_en: Free phone app or a box fan aimed at the wall
cheap_zh: 用手机免费App或把电扇对墙吹

cheap_zh: 干净小方巾或二手小毯即可；满12个月后可放床里

label_zh: 婴儿沐浴露洗发水和小毛巾

cheap_zh: 买自有品牌二合一；每周洗2–3次即可

cheap_zh: 自有品牌无香乳液；干燥处用凡士林

qty_en: 1 brush every 3 months; rice-grain smear twice daily
qty_zh: 牙刷每3个月换1把；每天刷2次，米粒大牙膏

cheap_zh: 买自有品牌；1岁前首次看牙在Medicaid/CHIP下免费

cheap_zh: 一元店即可；趁睡着或看视频时剪

cheap_zh: $8基础电子棒和$50额温枪一样准

qty_zh: 各1瓶；按体重给药，先问医生

cheap_zh: 自有品牌成分相同；满6个月后可用布洛芬

qty_zh: 每天400 IU（强化奶不足32盎司时）

cheap_zh: 自有品牌滴剂；WIC和诊所常免费发放

label_zh: 吸鼻器和生理盐水滴鼻液

cheap_zh: 医院诊所常免费给吸球；自制盐水：1杯凉开水加1/4茶匙盐

qty_en: 1 kit: bandages, antibiotic ointment, tweezers, gauze
qty_zh: 1套：创可贴、抗菌软膏、镊子、纱布
cheap_en: Assemble from the dollar store; walkers fall a lot
cheap_zh: 一元店自己配；学步期摔跤多

cheap_en: Store-brand zinc/titanium; hat and shade are free
cheap_zh: 自有品牌氧化锌款；戴帽遮阴不花钱

qty_en: 2 visits this stage (MMR, varicella, Hib, PCV boosters)
qty_zh: 本阶段2次（MMR、水痘、Hib、肺炎加强针）

cheap_zh: Medicaid/CHIP或VFC儿童疫苗项目在诊所、卫生局免费

cheap_zh: 一元店多件装就够全屋

qty_zh: 4–6条，每个柜子书架电视都固定

cheap_zh: 消防局和宜家常免费提供；幼儿爱爬，家具倾倒事故每年都有

cheap_zh: 双把手用橡皮筋捆住就免费；更好的办法是把化学品放高处

qty_zh: 1–2个；楼梯顶端必须是螺丝固定式

cheap_zh: 二手顶压式约$10用于门口；楼梯顶端绝不能用顶压式

qty_en: 1 pack for coffee table and TV stand

cheap_zh: 一元店泡棉条；或干脆先把尖角家具搬走

label_zh: 中毒急救电话和药品收纳盒

qty_zh: 1-800-222-1222贴冰箱；药品放带盖盒子高处

cheap_zh: 热线24小时免费；高处放个鞋盒就够用

qty_zh: 1个稳固推车（不要坐式学步车）

cheap_zh: 二手买，或推洗衣篮、餐椅；坐式学步车不安全，加拿大已禁

cheap_zh: Buy Nothing或旧货摊；$1的皮球最常玩

cheap_zh: 一元店买；在废纸和纸箱背面画

cheap_zh: 图书馆免费借书和故事时间；Imagination Library每月免费寄书；二手书5毛

qty_en: 1, packed with spare clothes, diapers, snacks, water

cheap_zh: 家里的双肩包就行；二手店$5

cheap_zh: 折起来的包巾或旧毛巾即可

cheap_zh: 一元店吸管杯；喝白水不喝果汁

cheap_zh: 自有品牌孕妇或成人复合维生素；WIC对部分哺乳妈妈免费提供

cheap_zh: 沃尔玛、Target两件装；不少WIC办公室免费发哺乳文胸

qty_en: 1 tube if nipples get sore from toddler nursing

cheap_zh: 纯羊脂膏，或挤点母乳涂上晾干

cheap_zh: Planned Parenthood、Title X诊所、社区健康中心免费或按收入收费；Medicaid产后常保一年

qty_en: Screen for depression/anxiety at least once this stage
qty_zh: 本阶段至少筛查一次情绪状况

cheap_zh: PSI免费热线1-800-944-4773和线上免费支持小组；产后抑郁可能持续或在一年后才出现

cheap_zh: 买超市自有品牌，大包装更便宜；可向当地尿布银行求助

cheap_zh: 超市自有品牌氧化锌；凡士林也能隔离

cheap_zh: 二手群或二手店淘，用稀释漂白水消毒

qty_zh: 每天3餐2点心，与家人同吃

cheap_zh: 用WIC和SNAP；冻蔬菜、鸡蛋、豆类、燕麦、香蕉；不必买果泥袋

cheap_en: Dollar store straw cups; small open cup teaches drinking best
cheap_zh: 一元店吸管杯；小敞口杯更利于学喝水

cheap_zh: 一元店即可；家里小茶匙也行

cheap_zh: 一元店塑料野餐盘

cheap_zh: 二手带安全带款；在cpsc.gov查召回

cheap_zh: 二手店、教会免费衣物处、邻里免费群

cheap_zh: 沃尔玛等平价店；鞋底要软，九成新二手也可

qty_zh: 外套1、保暖帽1、遮阳帽1、手套2双
cheap_en: Coat drives (Operation Warm, Salvation Army) are free
cheap_zh: 冬衣捐助活动可免费领取

cheap_en: Second-hand; or footed pajamas instead of a sack
cheap_zh: 二手；或直接穿连脚睡衣

qty_zh: 1张，会翻爬出来前继续用婴儿床

cheap_zh: 继续用现有婴儿床；可改装成幼儿床；床垫放地板也可

cheap_zh: 自有品牌；床单防水垫交替铺，夜里好更换

cheap_zh: 用绒布边角料自制；二手毛绒玩具高温洗

cheap_zh: 手机免费APP或家里的风扇

qty_zh: 每3个月换牙刷；每天2次，米粒大牙膏

cheap_zh: WIC和牙科诊所常免费发放；1岁前应首次看牙

cheap_en: Store brand 2-in-1; bathe 2–3x/week, not daily
cheap_zh: 自有品牌二合一；每周洗2-3次即可

cheap_en: Store-brand Cetaphil/Eucerin dupe in big tub
cheap_zh: 大罐装自有品牌替代品

cheap_en: Dollar store set; cut nails after bath
cheap_zh: 一元店一套；洗澡后剪指甲最好

cheap_en: Store-brand zinc stick/lotion; hats and shade are free
cheap_zh: 自有品牌氧化锌款；帽子和树荫免费

cheap_en: Basic $9 digital is as accurate as expensive forehead ones
cheap_zh: 9美元基础款和贵的额温枪一样准

qty_en: 1 bottle each; dose by weight, ask pediatrician
qty_zh: 各1瓶，按体重给药，先问医生
cheap_en: Store brand identical to Tylenol/Motrin; check expiration
cheap_zh: 自有品牌成分相同；注意保质期

label_zh: 维生素D滴剂（奶量不足时）

qty_zh: 每天奶量不足480毫升时补400-600IU
cheap_en: Store-brand drops last months; ask pediatrician first
cheap_zh: 自有品牌一瓶可用数月；先咨询儿科医生

label_zh: 生理盐水喷雾与吸鼻器
cheap_en: Bulb syringe often free from clinic; store-brand saline
cheap_zh: 诊所常免费给吸球；盐水买自有品牌

cheap_en: Free with Medicaid/CHIP; Vaccines for Children program covers uninsured
cheap_zh: Medicaid/CHIP全免；VFC项目为无保险儿童免费接种

qty_en: 1 kit with bandages, gauze, antibiotic ointment, tweezers
qty_zh: 1套：创可贴、纱布、抗生素软膏、镊子
cheap_en: Assemble from dollar store items
cheap_zh: 一元店自行配齐

qty_en: 1, keep rear-facing to the seat's max limit

cheap_zh: WIC、卫生局、Safe Kids可免费或低价提供；消防站免费检查安装

cheap_zh: 一元店多件装

cheap_zh: Safe Kids或医院安全项目常免费发放

qty_zh: 所有可触及的窗绳与窗户

cheap_zh: 一元店即可；3岁已能用普通小碗碟

cheap_en: Dollar store or reuse a sports bottle; buy 2 so one is always clean
cheap_zh: 一元店或用旧运动水壶；备2个轮换

qty_zh: 幼儿书包1个、保温饭盒袋1个
cheap_en: Free back-to-school backpack giveaways every August; thrift lunch bags
cheap_zh: 每年8月有免费返校书包发放；饭盒袋可买二手

qty_en: 3-5 half or full days a week
cheap_en: Head Start, state pre-K, and childcare subsidy vouchers are free or income-based; apply early, waitlists are long
cheap_zh: Head Start、州立pre-K、托育补助按收入免费；名额紧张要早申请

qty_en: Read 15-20 min daily; rotate 8-10 books weekly
cheap_en: Library card + story time is free; Dolly Parton Imagination Library mails a free book monthly to age 5
cheap_zh: 图书馆借阅和故事会免费；Imagination Library每月免费寄一本书到5岁

label_en: Crayons, washable markers, paper, safety scissors
label_zh: 蜡笔、可水洗马克笔、纸、安全剪刀
qty_en: Restock monthly; scissors build hand strength for writing
qty_zh: 每月补充；用剪刀练手部力量为写字做准备
cheap_en: August school-supply sales (crayons $0.50); draw on cardboard box and junk-mail backs
cheap_zh: 8月开学季促销很便宜；纸箱和废纸背面都能画

label_zh: 积木／磁力片／大颗粒拼插
cheap_en: Thrift and Buy Nothing have bins of used blocks; wash in a mesh bag; toy libraries lend free
cheap_zh: 二手店常有整箱积木，网袋洗一洗即可；玩具图书馆可免费借

cheap_en: Thrift at $1 each (count the pieces first); many libraries lend puzzles and games
cheap_zh: 二手店1美元一个（先数块数）；图书馆也可借

label_zh: 角色扮演道具（装扮、厨房、娃娃）
qty_en: A basket of props; peak pretend-play age
qty_zh: 一篮道具，这个年龄最爱假装游戏
cheap_en: Old scarves, hats, real pots and wooden spoons work better than toy sets
cheap_zh: 旧围巾、帽子、真锅和木勺比玩具套装更好玩

qty_zh: 每天户外活动1小时以上
cheap_en: Dollar store; free parks, splash pads and library programs do the rest
cheap_zh: 一元店买；公园、喷水池和图书馆活动都免费

cheap_en: Used from Facebook Marketplace/garage sales at $10-20; helmet matters more than the bike
cheap_zh: 二手市场10-20美元；头盔比车重要

cheap_en: Second-hand $10; many 4-year-olds walk fine without one
cheap_zh: 二手10美元；很多4岁孩子已可全程自己走

label_zh: 儿童洗发水、沐浴露、润肤乳
qty_en: Bath 2-3x/week; lotion daily if skin is dry
qty_zh: 每周洗澡2-3次；皮肤干就每天涂乳
cheap_en: Store-brand tear-free; plain petroleum jelly or Cetaphil-type cream for eczema
cheap_zh: 超市自有品牌无泪配方；湿疹用凡士林或平价保湿霜

cheap_en: A $15 home clipper set pays for itself in two cuts
cheap_zh: 买一套15美元电推剪，剪两次就回本

qty_zh: 持续消耗；幼儿园交叉感染多
cheap_en: Dollar store refills; plain soap and water beats sanitizer
cheap_zh: 一元店补充装；肥皂加流水比免洗液更有效

qty_zh: 每年1次，含宫颈筛查、血压、牙科
cheap_en: Free preventive care under ACA plans/Medicaid; Title X and FQHC clinics charge by income
cheap_zh: ACA/Medicaid预防性检查免费；社区诊所按收入收费

qty_en: Daily, especially if planning another pregnancy
qty_zh: 每天1片，尤其是备孕期间
cheap_en: Store-brand prenatal is cheap folic acid insurance; WIC may still cover you if breastfeeding a younger sibling
cheap_zh: 超市自有品牌孕产维生素便宜；若还在哺乳小宝宝，WIC可能仍覆盖

cheap_en: Free or sliding-scale at Title X clinics and Planned Parenthood; Medicaid covers all methods
cheap_zh: Title X诊所和计划生育机构免费或按收入收费；Medicaid全覆盖

qty_en: Weekly connection: group, friend, or counselor
qty_zh: 每周一次：小组、朋友或咨询
cheap_en: Free parent groups at libraries and Head Start; 988 line and PSI helpline are free 24/7
cheap_zh: 图书馆和Head Start有免费家长小组；988热线24小时免费

label_zh: 妈妈的运动鞋和基本衣物
qty_en: 1 pair supportive shoes/year, replace worn bras
qty_zh: 每年1双支撑好的鞋；内衣旧了就换
cheap_en: Outlet or thrift; chasing a preschooler all day ruins cheap flat shoes fast
cheap_zh: 奥特莱斯或二手店；整天追着孩子跑，平底薄鞋很快就废

label_en: ID card, emergency contacts, poison control number
label_zh: 身份信息卡、紧急联系人、中毒热线
qty_en: In backpack and on the fridge; Poison Control 1-800-222-1222
qty_zh: 贴冰箱并放书包；中毒热线1-800-222-1222
cheap_en: Free; also teach your child their full name and your phone number this year
cheap_zh: 免费；这一年也要教孩子说出全名和你的电话

cheap_en: Store-brand backless boosters run $18-25 new at Walmart; many fire departments and WIC/health departments give free or $10 seats. Never buy a used seat without a known history or past its expiration date stamped on the shell.
cheap_zh: 沃尔玛自有品牌无靠背增高垫新品约18-25美元；消防局或卫生局常有免费或10美元的座椅。不要买来历不明或已过壳上标注有效期的二手座椅。

qty_en: 1, replace after any crash or when outgrown
cheap_en: Safe Kids coalitions, police and hospital fairs hand out free fitted helmets; otherwise $12-15 at Walmart/Target. Must have CPSC sticker inside.
cheap_zh: Safe Kids、警局和医院活动常免费发放并帮忙调整头盔；否则沃尔玛约12-15美元。内部必须有CPSC标签。

qty_en: 6-7 tops, 5 bottoms, 10 underwear, 10 socks per season
qty_zh: 每季上衣6-7件、裤子5条、内裤10条、袜子10双
cheap_en: Thrift stores, Buy Nothing groups and end-of-season clearance; many schools and churches run free clothing closets and back-to-school giveaways.
cheap_zh: 二手店、Buy Nothing群和换季清仓；很多学校和教会有免费衣物室和开学物资发放。

qty_en: 1 pair every 4-6 months (feet grow ~1/2 size a year)
qty_zh: 每4-6个月1双（脚每年长约半码）
cheap_en: Walmart/Payless-style $15-20; check thrift for gently used. Shoes are one item worth buying new if soles are worn. Velcro saves time for kids who can't tie yet.
cheap_zh: 沃尔玛15-20美元即可；二手店挑鞋底未磨损的。鞋底磨损的二手鞋不要买。不会系鞋带的孩子选魔术贴款。

label_zh: 冬季外套、帽子、手套、雪靴
qty_en: 1 coat, 1 hat, 2 pairs gloves, 1 pair boots
qty_zh: 外套1件、帽子1顶、手套2副、雪靴1双
cheap_en: Operation Warm, Salvation Army and local coat drives give free winter coats each fall; thrift stores stock snow boots cheaply.
cheap_zh: 每年秋天Operation Warm、救世军等有免费冬衣发放；二手店雪靴很便宜。

qty_en: 1 backpack + the teacher's supply list each August
qty_zh: 书包1个＋每年8月老师的文具清单
cheap_en: Back-to-school giveaways (United Way, churches, Kiwanis) fill a backpack free; dollar store covers crayons, glue, folders.
cheap_zh: 开学物资发放活动（联合劝募、教会等）免费送装满的书包；一元店可买蜡笔、胶水、文件夹。

cheap_en: Dollar Tree or thrift; most public schools offer free or reduced-price breakfast and lunch, so apply — many districts are universal free.
cheap_zh: 一元店或二手店；公立学校多有免费或减价早午餐，记得申请，有些学区全员免费。

qty_zh: 每天三餐两点心；牛奶约480-600毫升
cheap_en: SNAP, school breakfast/lunch, summer EBT and free summer meal sites; food pantries. Buy store-brand oats, eggs, frozen vegetables, dried beans, bananas.
cheap_zh: 申请SNAP、学校早午餐、暑期EBT和免费暑期供餐点；食物银行。买自有品牌燕麦、鸡蛋、冷冻蔬菜、干豆、香蕉。

qty_en: New brush every 3 months; pea-size paste twice daily
qty_zh: 牙刷每3个月换；每天2次，豌豆大小牙膏
cheap_en: Store brand; dentists, WIC clinics and school dental days hand out free brushes and paste. Supervise brushing until about age 7-8.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌即可；牙医、WIC诊所和学校口腔日常免费发放。7-8岁前要督促/帮忙刷牙。

qty_en: 2 cleanings a year; sealants on first molars ~age 6
qty_zh: 每年洁牙2次；约6岁时第一恒磨牙做封闭
cheap_en: Medicaid/CHIP covers children's dental fully; many schools run free sealant programs, and dental schools and FQHC clinics use sliding-scale fees.
cheap_zh: Medicaid/CHIP全额覆盖儿童牙科；很多学校有免费封闭项目，牙科学院和社区诊所按收入收费。

label_en: Annual well-child visit and 4-6 yr vaccines
qty_en: 1 visit/year; DTaP, IPV, MMR, varicella boosters before kindergarten; flu shot yearly
qty_zh: 每年1次；入学前DTaP、IPV、MMR、水痘加强针；每年流感疫苗
cheap_en: Medicaid/CHIP and the Vaccines For Children program make shots free even if uninsured; health departments and school clinics also give them.
cheap_zh: Medicaid/CHIP和VFC项目让无保险儿童也能免费接种；卫生局和学校诊所也提供。

label_en: Vision and hearing screening (glasses if needed)
label_zh: 视力听力筛查（必要时配镜）
cheap_en: Schools screen free; Lions Club and Vision To Learn give free exams and glasses, and Medicaid covers one pair a year.
cheap_zh: 学校免费筛查；狮子会和Vision To Learn提供免费验光配镜，Medicaid每年覆盖一副。

cheap_en: Store brand is identical to Tylenol/Motrin at half the price. Check expiration yearly and dose by weight, not age.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌与品牌药成分相同、价格减半。每年检查有效期，按体重而非年龄给药。

label_en: First aid kit (bandages, antibiotic ointment, tweezers)
label_zh: 急救包（创可贴、抗菌软膏、镊子）
cheap_en: Build it yourself from dollar-store bandages, gauze, tape and a tube of generic bacitracin — cheaper than pre-made kits.
cheap_zh: 自己用一元店的创可贴、纱布、胶带和普通抗菌软膏组装，比成品急救包便宜。

cheap_en: A $5-8 stick thermometer is as accurate as a $40 forehead scanner at this age.
cheap_zh: 5-8美元的棒式体温计在这个年龄与40美元额温枪一样准确。

cheap_en: Store-brand SPF 50 works the same; buy the biggest bottle and reapply every 2 hours outdoors.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌SPF50效果相同；买大瓶装，户外每2小时补涂。

qty_en: Bath or shower most nights; wash hair 2-3x/week
qty_zh: 多数晚上洗澡；每周洗头2-3次
cheap_en: One family-size bottle of gentle store-brand wash does for everyone; plain petroleum jelly or generic Eucerin for dry skin.
cheap_zh: 一瓶家庭装温和自有品牌沐浴露全家共用；干燥皮肤用凡士林或平价保湿霜。

label_zh: 护发用品（梳子、顺发喷雾、发圈）
qty_en: 1 comb/brush, detangler, pack of ties or clips
qty_zh: 梳子1把、顺发喷雾、发圈若干
cheap_en: Dollar store; a cheap wide-tooth comb plus diluted conditioner in a spray bottle works as detangler.
cheap_zh: 一元店即可；宽齿梳加喷瓶里稀释的护发素就是顺发喷雾。

qty_en: Keep on hand; school outbreaks are common at this age
qty_zh: 常备；学龄期学校常有虱子传播
cheap_en: A metal nit comb ($5) plus careful wet-combing with conditioner works without buying repeated chemical kits.
cheap_zh: 金属篦子（约5美元）配护发素湿梳即可，不必反复购买药剂。

qty_zh: 床1张、床笠2条、被子1床、枕头1个
cheap_en: Buy Nothing, Facebook Marketplace and furniture banks give away twin frames; buy the mattress new or recently used only, and sheets at thrift.
cheap_zh: Buy Nothing、Marketplace和家具银行常送单人床架；床垫尽量买新或较新的，床单可买二手。

cheap_en: $1-3 plug-in LED at the dollar store; helps with the common age-5 fear of the dark and night trips to the bathroom.
cheap_zh: 一元店1-3美元的LED插座灯；帮助缓解5岁常见怕黑，夜间上厕所也方便。

cheap_en: Bedwetting at 5-6 is normal and usually outgrown; a $10 vinyl-backed protector plus a spare sheet beats buying pull-ups long-term.
cheap_zh: 5-6岁尿床很常见、多会自愈；10美元的防水垫加一套备用床单比长期买拉拉裤划算。

qty_en: Read together 15-20 min daily; 5-10 books in rotation
cheap_en: Public library card is free and includes early-reader sets, audiobooks and summer reading prizes; Little Free Libraries, thrift stores and Dolly Parton's Imagination Library (through age 5) add free books.
cheap_zh: 图书馆借书免费，还有分级读物、有声书和暑期阅读奖励；小小免费图书箱、二手店和Imagination Library（5岁前）也免费送书。

cheap_en: Dollar store and August back-to-school sales (crayons 50 cents); the back of junk mail and paper grocery bags make free drawing paper.
cheap_zh: 一元店和8月开学特价（蜡笔约0.5美元）；广告纸背面和纸袋就是免费画纸。

qty_en: 1 bulk tub, sorted into a bin
cheap_en: Thrift stores sell bricks by the bag; Buy Nothing groups are full of them. Loose bulk bricks beat themed sets for open-ended play.
cheap_zh: 二手店按袋卖积木；Buy Nothing群很多人送。散装积木比主题套装更能激发想象。

cheap_en: Thrift shops sell games for $1-3 (check pieces); many libraries lend games and puzzles free. A deck of cards teaches dozens of games.
cheap_zh: 二手店1-3美元一套（检查配件是否齐全）；很多图书馆免费外借桌游拼图。一副扑克就能玩很多游戏。

cheap_en: Yard sales, Marketplace and bike co-ops sell kids' bikes for $15-30 and will tune them up free; many cities run free kids' bike giveaways.
cheap_zh: 庭院旧货、Marketplace和自行车合作社15-30美元就能买到，还免费调试；不少城市有儿童自行车免费发放。

cheap_en: Dollar store covers all three; 60 minutes of active play a day is the goal and parks are free.
cheap_zh: 一元店全部搞定；每天目标60分钟活动，公园免费。

cheap_en: YMCA and city parks departments offer scholarship/sliding-scale rates, often $0-40 for a session; drowning is a leading cause of death at this age.
cheap_zh: YMCA和市政公园部门有奖学金或按收入收费，常为0-40美元一期；溺水是该年龄的主要死因之一。

label_en: Reflective gear / safety know-how for walking to school
label_zh: 反光条等上学路上的安全装备
qty_en: Reflective strips or vest; practice the route together
qty_zh: 反光贴或背心；和孩子一起走熟路线
cheap_en: Dollar-store reflective tape on the backpack; schools often hand out free slap bands at safety events.
cheap_zh: 一元店反光胶带贴在书包上；学校安全活动常免费发放反光手环。

label_en: Locked storage for medicines, cleaners, firearms
label_zh: 药品、清洁剂、枪支上锁存放
qty_en: 1 lockbox or latch set; curious 5-year-olds can climb
qty_zh: 1个锁盒或锁扣；5岁孩子会爬会开
cheap_en: Many health departments and police give free cable gun locks and medication lockboxes; a $3 cabinet latch handles cleaners.
cheap_zh: 很多卫生局和警局免费发放枪锁和药品锁盒；3美元的橱柜锁扣就能锁住清洁剂。

label_en: Smoke and CO alarms + fire escape plan
label_zh: 烟雾和一氧化碳报警器＋逃生计划
qty_en: 1 per floor and outside bedrooms; test monthly
qty_zh: 每层和卧室外各1个；每月测试
cheap_en: Fire departments and the Red Cross install free smoke alarms on request. Practice the escape plan with your child twice a year.
cheap_zh: 消防局和红十字会可上门免费安装烟雾报警器。每年和孩子演练两次逃生路线。

cheap_en: A $12 clipper set pays for itself in two cuts; beauty schools charge $5-8.
cheap_zh: 12美元的理发推子剪两次就回本；美容学校只收5-8美元。

cheap_en: 21st Century/CCAMPIS grants, Boys & Girls Club and YMCA sliding scale often bring this to $0-50/month; ask your state child care subsidy office.
cheap_zh: 21st Century项目、Boys & Girls Club和YMCA按收入收费，常降到每月0-50美元；向州托育补贴部门咨询。

label_en: Free outings: library programs, parks, museum passes
label_zh: 免费外出：图书馆活动、公园、博物馆通票
cheap_en: Library cards unlock free museum and zoo passes in most cities; Museums For All admits SNAP/EBT families for $0-3.
cheap_zh: 多数城市凭借书证可免费借博物馆、动物园通票；Museums For All对SNAP家庭收0-3美元。

label_en: Mom's own checkup and mental health care
label_zh: 妈妈的体检和心理健康
qty_zh: 每年1次体检；筛查抑郁焦虑
cheap_en: FQHC community health centers charge on a sliding scale regardless of insurance; 988 and Postpartum Support International lines are free.
cheap_zh: 社区健康中心（FQHC）按收入收费，无保险也可；988热线和PSI热线免费。

label_zh: 妈妈的含铁复合维生素
cheap_en: Store-brand multivitamin is a few dollars for 100 days; useful if periods are heavy or meals are skipped to feed the kids.
cheap_zh: 自有品牌100天份只要几美元；月经量大或自己常少吃一餐时很有用。
